messages:
marie-peopleops: Heads-up: Compliance window opens Mon Jul 6 and closes Jul 20 23:59 UTC. Everyone with a Redwood account must attest or upload required evidence. Form + Evidence Locker: https://intra.redwood/attest_july2026 :calendar:

marie-peopleops: New checklist item this round: if you manage third-party model providers include a one-line data residency note and vendor contact in the upload metadata.

raja-englead: Quick Q: For inference teams, is an anonymized sample dataflow + ACL screenshot sufficient for data access controls?

kelly-security: Yes. An anonymized dataflow diagram + timestamped ACL export or screenshot + owner note is acceptable. For throughput controls, include a short note on rate-limiting config if applicable.

anu-privacy: Reminder: please complete the 12-min privacy micro-course before attesting. The attestation form will detect training status and surface the link if missing. Training deadline is Jul 16 to allow reviewers time.

notify-bot: Scheduled: "Jul attestation window open" will post to #general on Jul 8 09:00 UTC and send an email reminder on Jul 15.

marie-peopleops: Office hours: Jul 13 15:00-16:00 UTC with people-ops + security. Book a 1:1 in the form for sensitive uploads.

raja-englead: We'll collect at team level and nominate a lead submitter. Please DM me any edge-case vendor items by Jul 12.

kelly-security: Uploads marked "for review" will get statuses: accepted / needs-info / escalate. We aim to complete reviews by Jul 27. For audit-priority items add "audit:urgent" in the filename.

marie-peopleops: TL;DR: attest + evidence due Jul 20 23:59 UTC; privacy training done by Jul 16; vendor notes required for external models; office hours Jul 13. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
